collision_check: Searched all 180 openkit-*/fbx for pouch|drawstring|flap|eyelet|bag|rivet|cord|panel. Only hits were prop-rivet-anvil-hm1 and prop-lead-weight-bag. None of the 4 ids are taken, and no openkit-pouch* or openkit-hat* pack existed.
judgment_calls: Panel and flap are flat undyed cutouts with chalk lines, an offcut tab, a scored crease, and an uncut slit. They are not sewn pouches and not icon-* glyphs
Cord coil is a thin 3 mm waxed drawstring coil with a whipped end and a beeswax cake. It is much finer than rope coils or twine balls
Tray is shallow and split into copper rivet and brass eyelet bays. It holds pouch fittings, not belt buckles or straps
Eye-check pass 1 found eyelets floating 3 mm above the tray floor, a panel rounded bottom offset by scaling, and chalk lines too long. All were fixed. Pass 2 shows no floating parts
Tray is 228 tris with lathed eyelets. Box eyelets bring it to 156
